Class RegistrationEmailListener

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.iam.client.RegistrationEmailListener
@Component public class RegistrationEmailListener extends Object
Sends the emails a registration request leads to, once the request has committed, so a confirmation link never arrives before it works. The email is handed to another thread: how many go out depends on whether the applicant's details were already registered, and the request must not take longer to answer because of it. Nothing here throws: the applicant was told to check their email either way, so a mail failure is logged and they simply apply again. The confirmation link is a credential and is never logged.
